name: io.github.wyattpalm2-eng/x402-seller
title: x402-seller — rug, honeypot & fake-volume checks for trading agents
description: Rug, honeypot & fake-volume checks plus market pulse for trading agents. EVM+Solana, x402.

tools.name: vet_token
tools.description: Go/no-go verdict on a token before trading it: composite rug score (static analysis + live buy/sell simulation + LP-lock/liquidity-pull gate) + market → clear/caution/avoid with reasons. EVM + Solana. FREE demo (shared daily budget); unlimited via the paid HTTP API.

tools.name: launch_radar
tools.description: Discover what just launched AND rug-screen it in one call: fresh token launches ranked by liquidity depth (deepest first), with a per-token rug verdict, each with a verdict (a clean contract with unlocked LP is caution, not clear — most fresh rugs are liquidity pulls). The proactive 'safe alpha' feed. FREE demo (shared daily budget).

tools.name: rug_check
tools.description: Detailed composite rug/honeypot report for one token: red/green flags, 0-100 risk, live-simulation results, disagreement flag. EVM + Solana. FREE demo (shared daily budget).

tools.name: weather_consensus
tools.description: Cross-source weather consensus for any coordinates: blends Open-Meteo + NOAA/NWS + 7Timer into one temperature with an agreement score (how much independent models agree). Keyless multi-source ground truth in one call — built by the autonomous crew, ported through the bridge. FREE demo (shared daily budget); unlimited via the paid HTTP API (/weather/consensus, $0.01).

tools.name: market_pulse
tools.description: The whole crypto market in one answer: overall risk_on / risk_off regime from BTC, ETH and SOL (price move, perp funding, sentiment), market breadth across liquid coins, top gainers and losers, and fear/greed, each with reasons. The call to make before any trade. FREE demo (shared daily budget); unlimited via the paid HTTP API (/pulse, $0.003).

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Biggest 24h gainers and losers among actively traded coins (at least $2M of 24h volume, so no thin-pair 'pumps'), plus breadth and the most-traded coins. Each mover shows where it sits in its day range. FREE demo (shared daily budget); unlimited via the paid HTTP API (/movers, $0.003).

tools.name: truth
tools.description: FREE, always: the Truth Engine — every endpoint this service sells grades itself against reality in public (rug verdicts vs actual rugs, weather forecasts vs the ERA5 archive, market calls vs realized spot). Returns the doctrine + all three live ledgers' summaries. Judge us by receipts, not claims.

tools.name: track_record
tools.description: FREE, always: the service's public self-graded track record — its rug verdicts on fresh launches graded against what actually happened, hits AND misses. Judge the scorer by its receipts.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: FREE: what x402-seller sells, prices, and how to pay. The paid HTTP API is keyless (pay per call in USDC on Base via x402).
